import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def solve():
    data = input().split()
    x = int(data[0])
    y = int(data[1])
    n = int(data[2])

    MOD = 1000000007

    # The sequence can be reduced to a cycle of length 6
    f = [x, y, y-x, -x, -y, x-y]
    
    # The nth term (1-indexed) corresponds to the (n-1)%6-th term in this reduced sequence
    result = f[(n-1) % 6] % MOD

    # Adjust for negative results
    result = (result + MOD) % MOD

    print(result)

solve()
